name: Gemini API Model Pricing JSON
description:
1. The system initially instructed the assistant to include explicit file paths in the language headers of all code blocks.
2. In response, the assistant generated a JSON code block mapped to the file path `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/model_prices.json`.
3. This generated JSON file contains an array of pricing data for various hypothetical and future Gemini AI models.
4. Each entry specifies a distinct model name alongside its respective input and output cost per 1,000 tokens.
5. Finally, the user submitted a prompt requesting exactly a five-line summary of these preceding interactions.
